test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows.

Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) £ * 6 @ 1 £ 8 6 @ % $ 7 # 1 9 # 6 % * 5 € & (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
Given series: (Left) £ * 6 @ 1 £ 8 6 @ % $ 7 # 1 9 # 6 % * 5 € & (Right)

According to the question,

Required condition: Symbol - Number - Symbol

(Left) £ __*** 6 @ 1 £**__ 8 6 @ % __**$ 7 #**__ 1 9 __**# 6 %**__ __*** 5 €**__ & (Right)

Thus, there are five such numbers which are immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer
